name: 110lab-assessment · 分层验收
scope: 构建、全量现有回归、接口数据库、管理员浏览器、依赖/密钥扫描与逻辑恢复；未覆盖的必验项阻止整体放行

criteria.title: 三个工作区可构建
criteria.expected: 服务端、Web 和 MCP bridge 构建成功，并生成三个入口产物
criteria.limitation: 仅证明构建；不证明功能正确
test_names: BUILD

criteria.title: 客户端业务规则回归
criteria.expected: 执行已登记的 18 个测试；无失败或跳过
criteria.limitation: 现有项目测试；测试失败需区分产品缺陷与过期测试。外部提供方使用合成响应。
test_names: remaining time keeps hours above 24 instead of wrapping
the start window is open at the open instant and closed at the close instant
timestamps render as Beijing time
duration reads stay exact and never fall back to 24
start is allowed only for a confirmed 24 or 48 hour duration inside the window
future open batches can be enrolled while start stays closed until the window
description warnings detect explicit 24 or 48 hour wording without rewriting it
Beijing date input has a stable UTC instant and rejects normalized invalid dates
central enrollment normalization retains the captured duration without a fallback
headings, emphasis, nested lists, blockquotes and tables render as elements
old plain text keeps line breaks without changing literal backslash-n
fenced code is escaped and never executed
raw HTML, event handlers, forms, frames and SVG stay inert
unsafe URL protocols and entity encodings cannot become links or images
ordinary links and images work with safe navigation and no referrer
empty and repeated renders never carry content across documents
account connection callback survives login/register for candidates and exam admins
account bridge does not broaden external or administrative redirects

criteria.title: MCP bridge 协议回归
criteria.expected: 执行已登记的 27 个测试；无失败或跳过
criteria.limitation: 现有项目测试；测试失败需区分产品缺陷与过期测试。外部提供方使用合成响应。
test_names: submit_files streams raw bytes and does not return or forward contents
submit_files refuses a symlink that escapes the root
canonical JSON sorts object keys and keeps array order
canonical hash is stable across key order and uses UTF-8
config requires an explicit workspace and rejects credential URLs and home
diagnostics drop paths and secrets
ticket url and token stay on https or loopback
upload resumes after an offset conflict and does not follow redirects
oversized and symlink files are rejected before a ticket is opened
auto scan matches workspace Codex files and does not follow symlinks
user-selected Cursor export is partial history and random text is unsupported
bundle hash matches canonical payload and redacts secrets without system prompts
explicit generic project exports are accepted without returning file content
redacts credential markers and leaves ordinary prose
payload accepts unicode file names and rejects empty clients or a short repo SHA
rejects filesystem root and the home directory as scan roots
containment rejects sibling prefixes and symlink escapes
line reader skips an oversized line and keeps the next line
snapshot uploads exact binary bytes and leaves the source unchanged
append after capture is excluded and the strict default still rejects it
capture accepts an append and rejects truncation, rewrite, and replacement
snapshot enforces limits before a ticket and removes temps after a failed upload
a changed capture conflicts instead of replacing the ticket manifest
startup does not write protocol traffic or the token
npm-style symlink starts the bridge
Codex projection keeps visible user and assistant text only
Cursor raw files over 8MB are marked truncated without reading the tail

criteria.title: 接口权限、存储与 1 GiB 上传
criteria.expected: 执行已登记的 65 个测试；无失败或跳过
criteria.limitation: 现有项目测试；测试失败需区分产品缺陷与过期测试。外部提供方使用合成响应。
test_names: rejects non-admin, bad confirmation, and missing targets without deleting
deletes an empty round and a childless batch, and refuses rounds or batches that still have children
deletes an unassigned question but keeps shared attachments and assigned history
new enrollment or upload makes an old preview unusable, and a busy upload lock returns 409
enrollment deletion removes one finalized attempt and leaves the account and other attempt
candidate deletion invalidates login, frees identifiers, and never removes an admin
file purge retries a failed removal and does not follow or recurse raw paths
unused questions come first, editorial versions do not count, existing assignments stay locked
new questions catch up with historical imbalance before heavily used questions get another participant
finalized and expired participants count; unpublished, other direction and other batch questions stay out
concurrent starts across independent connections remain even and duplicate requests cannot reroll
an empty published pool leaves the attempt unstarted and can be retried after publication
embedding is off by default and accepts only a bounded exact origin list over HTTPS
embedded login has a separate partitioned session and preserves origin, CSRF, and ordinary sessions
auth codes are one-time, throttled, and CSRF/origin protected
one round enrollment, hidden questions, concurrent start, and immutable snapshot
repo SHA pin, approval, idempotent submit, deadline, and stable finalize receipt
different candidates can start the same one-question pool
direct upload preserves original bytes >1MB, resumes, separates consent and returns idempotent receipt
direct upload enforces aggregate1GiB, exact hashes, repository changes, revoked and expired tickets
replaced uploads release storage, repo change frees reservations, extension preserves live tickets
1GiB real HTTP chunk transfer stays bounded in memory and completes
history includes inactive batches and unpublished retention clears approvals
expired verification mail is removed without dropping password-reset or ordinary pending mail
discovers metadata and rejects unsafe dynamic registration
native fallback completes OAuth and reconnects with a new loopback port
authorization port flexibility rejects all other callback changes without redirecting
requires S256 and the assessment resource and scope
binds consent to the session, CSRF token, and initiating browser
rejects expired, replayed, and concurrent authorization codes
rotates refresh tokens and revokes the grant on replay
revokes one grant without dropping the other, then clears the preflight flag
rejects finalized and expired exams for access and refresh
keeps legacy bearer MCP working and ignores the browser session
completes the official SDK OAuth handshake and calls MCP tools
loopback authorization accepts ephemeral ports while preserving the registered callback
the port exception cannot change hosts, schemes, credentials, paths or query bytes
registration rejects custom schemes and unsafe callback forms
legacy origins accept bounded exact HTTPS origins only
canonical and legacy hosts preserve their own OAuth origin, origin checks, and registration secrets
registration mail budgets are optional validated config
embedded registration uses a separate partitioned cookie and cannot consume a regular browser proof
stops challenge issuance before storing another challenge when the IP bucket is empty
rejects missing, forged, mismatched, replayed, and expired proofs
cooldown and queue budgets are atomic and do not block reset
rolling mail budget survives token refill and concurrent sends
checks the email code before hashing and consumes it once
flags shared browsers and IPs without blocking start until an admin says so
canonical JSON sorts keys, keeps array order, and has a stable hash
secret markers ignore ordinary prose
csv cells neutralize spreadsheet formulas
repository URLs allow only public github and gitee
passwords verify and reject malformed hashes
production refuses demo seed and test mail
material payload hash covers sorted content and rejects paths or secrets
persists only 24 or 48 hours and allows preparation before the batch opens
operator restriction gates real starts without interrupting an active attempt
start user lock remains compatible with enrollment foreign-key checks
rejects a stale duration, then keeps the captured snapshot when the batch changes
a 48 hour attempt continues after the batch window and CLOSED status
extension leaves revoked tokens and expired upload tickets dead, without finalizing
start is inclusive at opensAt, exclusive at startClosesAt, and loses a close race
concurrent starts capture one clock and do not deadlock with an admin edit
migration backfills 24 hour snapshots without moving extended deadlines
policy and demo copy follow the batch length without changing the consent contract

criteria.title: 迁移与历史缺陷回归
criteria.expected: 执行已登记的 17 个测试；无失败或跳过
criteria.limitation: 现有项目测试；测试失败需区分产品缺陷与过期测试。外部提供方使用合成响应。
test_names: Missing repository blocks finalization without reporting a version conflict
Missing materials blocks finalization without reporting a version conflict
Missing both submissions blocks finalization without reporting a version conflict
Matching submissions permit finalization while the exam is active
A real repository/material version conflict remains visible and blocks finalization
finalized does not expose an active exam or permit finalization
final receipt received before state refresh does not expose an active exam or permit finalization
expired does not expose an active exam or permit finalization
exact deadline does not expose an active exam or permit finalization
past deadline does not expose an active exam or permit finalization
not started does not expose an active exam or permit finalization
001 upgrade preserves data and changes only documented upload columns; startup is repeatable
Canonical JSON preserves own __proto__ keys without modifying prototypes
Context projection excludes internal reasoning and system/developer messages
Common local context secrets are redacted without altering source files
Auth bootstrapping and verification attempts remain durable
Quoted credentials, URL schemes and incomplete PEM blocks are fully removed

criteria.limitation: Linux 容器执行；Windows 模拟不代替原生 Windows

criteria.title: 密钥规则命中待核实
criteria.expected: 扫描冻结源文件，不遗漏规则命中；命中需逐条复核
criteria.limitation: 仅文件快照，无 Git 历史。合成测试令牌可能命中；不得直接称为真实密钥泄露。
test_names: SECRET-SCAN

criteria.title: 锁定依赖存在已知漏洞
criteria.limitation: 公共 npm 审计只覆盖已知通告；命中不等于生产调用路径可利用。
test_names: DEPENDENCY-AUDIT

criteria.title: 管理员登录与轮次持久化
criteria.expected: 访客和错误密码被拒绝；管理员创建轮次后刷新可见；退出后保护后台
criteria.limitation: 单浏览器、合成管理员流程；不代表候选人完整交卷流程
test_names: BROWSER-ADMIN

criteria.title: 登录页可访问名称
criteria.expected: axe-core label、button-name、link-name 规则无违规或待人工判断项
criteria.limitation: 仅三个指定规则；不代表完整 WCAG 审计
test_names: BROWSER-A11Y

criteria.title: 合成数据库逻辑备份恢复
criteria.expected: pg_dump 后恢复到新库，全部样本表行数及内容摘要一致
criteria.limitation: 只覆盖合成 PostgreSQL 数据；不包括上传文件、灾备环境及 RTO/RPO
test_names: DB-RESTORE

criteria.title: 完整代码与动态安全验证
criteria.expected: 该必验范围取得独立可核对的有效结果
criteria.limitation: 尚未接入本项目的完整 SAST/DAST 规则及攻击路径复验；依赖和密钥扫描不能代替。
test_names: FULL-SECURITY
criteria.gap: 尚未接入本项目的完整 SAST/DAST 规则及攻击路径复验；依赖和密钥扫描不能代替。

criteria.title: 真实外部服务联调
criteria.expected: 该必验范围取得独立可核对的有效结果
criteria.limitation: 邮件、GitHub、外部 OAuth 采用合成响应；尚无专用测试租户及凭据。
test_names: LIVE-PROVIDERS
criteria.gap: 邮件、GitHub、外部 OAuth 采用合成响应；尚无专用测试租户及凭据。

criteria.title: 候选人完整交卷流程
criteria.expected: 该必验范围取得独立可核对的有效结果
criteria.limitation: 浏览器仅覆盖管理员流程；候选人注册、领取、材料上传、确认交卷的独立端到端用例尚未接入。
test_names: CANDIDATE-E2E
criteria.gap: 浏览器仅覆盖管理员流程；候选人注册、领取、材料上传、确认交卷的独立端到端用例尚未接入。

criteria.title: 并发性能与持续负载
criteria.expected: 该必验范围取得独立可核对的有效结果
criteria.limitation: 1 GiB 上传回归不等于负载验收；并发量、延迟、错误率及持续时间目标尚未定义。
test_names: LOAD-SLO
criteria.gap: 1 GiB 上传回归不等于负载验收；并发量、延迟、错误率及持续时间目标尚未定义。

criteria.title: 数据库与材料联合恢复
criteria.expected: 该必验范围取得独立可核对的有效结果
criteria.limitation: 尚未接入上传文件联合恢复、故障切换及 RTO/RPO 验证。
test_names: FULL-RESTORE
criteria.gap: 尚未接入上传文件联合恢复、故障切换及 RTO/RPO 验证。
